## Description

Replaces `REPLICATION.md` with the filled version `generated/REPLICATION-filled.md` from [24_amend_report.sh](#help-24_amend_report), but only while `REPLICATION.md` is still the blank template. It checks this against `generated/REPLICATION.sha256`, which the template ships with. When the checksum is missing or no longer matches (the report was already edited), the script leaves the report alone.

After replacing the report, it splits it into `REPLICATION-PartA.md` and `REPLICATION-PartB.md` at the line "You are starting *PartB*.", and commits both ("Added split report").

## Usage

```bash
./automations/25_replace_report.sh
```

### Environment Variables

- `SkipProcessing` - When `yes`, the script exits immediately.
- `jiraticket` - When set, commit messages start with `<jiraticket> #comment [skip ci]`; otherwise with `[skip ci]`.
